items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: That's when Lindsay walked the streets, you know, (unintelligible) doing all that.

ctx.x: did. Brilliant dude. He loves Jimmy Blanton (PHONETIC). To me, the young man can play almost every solo Jimmy has played. He's a father of about seven, eight children, now a grandfather like myself. But he's not playing regular. It's kind of hard for him. But he's doing beautiful, though. Wonderful wife, Evelyn, grew up together, and they stuck together, which is what it's all about.

Well, anyway, I decided to come back to New York. That was around August, around July. I left Chicago just before the riot started out there, and I got to New York, where they had another riot up there in Harlem. That's when Lindsay walked the streets, you know, (unintelligible) doing all that.
